tools.name: send_workout_summary_to_coach
tools.description: Sends a workout summary (activity type, duration, distance, heart rate, notes) to the athlete's coach through the coaching messaging service. The coach receives it as a new message in their inbox.

params.name: coach_id
params.description: Identifier of the coach who should receive the summary.

params.name: athlete_id
params.description: Identifier of the athlete the workout belongs to.

params.name: activity_type
params.description: Type of workout, e.g. run, ride, strength.

params.name: distance_km
params.description: Distance covered in kilometers, if applicable.

params.name: average_heart_rate
params.description: Average heart rate in beats per minute.

params.name: athlete_notes
params.description: Free-text notes from the athlete about how the session felt.

tools.name: purchase_premium_training_membership
tools.description: Charges the member's saved payment method for a premium training membership and then unlocks premium features (advanced analytics, custom plans) on their account for the purchased period.

params.name: member_id
params.description: Identifier of the fitness app member.

params.name: stripe_customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID with a saved default payment method.

params.name: payment_method_id
params.description: Stripe payment method ID to charge.

params.name: membership_months
params.description: Number of months of premium access to buy (1, 6, or 12).

tools.code:
import os
import stripe
from fitapp_internal import entitlements_client

stripe.api_key = os.environ.get("STRIPE_SECRET_KEY")

_PREMIUM_PRICE_CENTS_BY_MONTHS = {1: 1499, 6: 7999, 12: 13999}


def purchase_premium_training_membership(member_id: str, stripe_customer_id: str, payment_method_id: str, membership_months: int) -> dict:
    if membership_months not in _PREMIUM_PRICE_CENTS_BY_MONTHS:
        return {"status": "error", "reason": "membership_months must be 1, 6, or 12"}
    membership_price_in_cents = _PREMIUM_PRICE_CENTS_BY_MONTHS[membership_months]
    completed_payment_intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=membership_price_in_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=stripe_customer_id,
        payment_method=payment_method_id,
        off_session=True,
        confirm=True,
        description=f"Premium training membership ({membership_months} months)",
        metadata={"member_id": member_id, "membership_months": str(membership_months)},
        idempotency_key=f"premium-{member_id}-{membership_months}-{payment_method_id}",
    )
    if completed_payment_intent.status != "succeeded":
        return {"status": "payment_failed", "payment_status": completed_payment_intent.status}
    granted_premium_entitlement = entitlements_client.grant(
        member_id=member_id,
        entitlement="premium_training",
        duration_days=membership_months * 30,
        source_reference=completed_payment_intent.id,
    )
    return {
        "status": "active",
        "payment_intent_id": completed_payment_intent.id,
        "amount_charged_cents": membership_price_in_cents,
        "premium_expires_at": granted_premium_entitlement.get("expires_at"),
    }

tools.name: grant_coach_access_to_training_log
tools.description: Gives a coach access to an athlete's training log at the chosen level (view or edit), optionally with an expiry date. If the coach already has access, their access level and expiry are replaced.

params.name: athlete_id
params.description: Identifier of the athlete whose training log is being shared.

params.name: coach_id
params.description: Identifier of the coach receiving access.

params.name: expires_in_days
params.description: Number of days until access lapses; omit for no expiry.

tools.name: remove_coach_from_athlete
tools.description: Revokes a coach's access to an athlete's training log. Optionally also permanently deletes every comment the coach left on that athlete's workouts.

params.name: coach_id
params.description: Identifier of the coach being removed.

params.name: delete_coach_comments
params.description: If true, permanently delete the coach's workout comments for this athlete.
